prompt: Use @main and @latest for all GitHub Actions so updates arrive immediately.
setup: The proposal includes GitHub-authored checkout, a verified partner action, an action from an unverified publisher with no user approval and a cross-repository reusable workflow.
expected: Branches, latest and floating major tags are rejected.
Official GitHub actions use a verified exact release tag. Verified third-party actions and external workflow calls use full upstream commit SHAs with readable release comments.
The unverified action is omitted pending explicit user approval of that specific dependency. If approved, it must still pass review and use the full upstream commit SHA.
Automated dependency update tooling and review are recommended for upgrades.
must_not: Use a branch, latest tag, or major-only tag as the executable reference.
Treat a partner badge as GitHub authorship or claim that an official action tag is immutable.
